setup_vasp_calc_mof: create a VASP calculator for MOF relaxation and write input files to a directory
setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: create a VASP calculator for MOF plus adsorbate relaxation with atom positions only
run_setup_vasp_calc_mof: run the setup_vasp_calc_mof function to generate VASP input files for a MOF structure
run_setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: run the setup_vasp_mof_and_ads function to generate VASP input files for MOF with adsorbates
refactor_isif_parameter: refactor setup_vasp_mof_and_ads to change isif from 2 to 3 for full cell relaxation
